facts.fact: KRAY 在回到电脑屏幕前，顺路去总部星巴克买一杯 Tall Bold With Room。
facts.anchor: KRAY, hands scrubbed clean, decided to stop by the Headquarters Starbucks for a Tall Bold With Room before heading back to his computer screen

facts.fact: 小个子男人自称 Howard W. BUTTONFLY，化名 Pseudo's BUTTONFLY。
KRAY 说自己即将满十年，此前主要以外派单干身份在远处看总部。
facts.anchor: I’m coming up on ten years. But I’ve been out mainly as a singleton, looking at Headquarters from far away through a telescope

facts.fact: BUTTONFLY 说 CIA 已变成附带情报收集机构的官僚体制。
facts.anchor: We turned into a bureaucracy with an intelligence collection outfit attached to it as an appendage

facts.fact: BUTTONFLY 1963 年报到的第一天就被 McCone 局长派往加州 Burbank 参与 OXCART 项目。
facts.anchor: As soon as I showed up at Headquarters for my first day on the job back in ’63, Director McCone sent me off to Burbank, California

facts.fact: KRAY 的部门主管是 Ignatius Q. HECKFETTER。
BUTTONFLY 认为 CIA 百分之九十三的员工不应动。
facts.anchor: Nothing should be done with ninety-three percent of the Agency’s workforce.

facts.fact: KRAY 说这是他在 CIA 以来与同事最好的一次谈话。
facts.anchor: this has been the single best conversation I’ve had with a colleague since I joined CIA
